name: Aogashima (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Aogashima village emblem in white: a ring enclosing a triangle of three smaller triangles, like a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Aogashima, a village in Tokyo; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 28 June 1974.

features.role: Aogashima village emblem — a ring enclosing a triangle of three smaller triangles, like a stylised character
